title: MagicMirror_MusicLearningCompanion Marketplace index, schema 1
description: index.json at the top of this repository, built and signed by tools/market_tool.py build-index. The Ed25519 signature over its exact bytes is in index.json.sig ({alg, key, sig}). Mirrors verify both offline with keys/*.pub, refuse a serial lower than one they have seen, and check each package's own signature.

serial.description: Goes up by one at every rebuild. A mirror refuses a list older than one it has seen.

generated.description: UTC time of the build, ISO 8601.

manifest.description: The package's manifest.json, exactly as in the zip.

source.description: The zip (a GitHub release asset of the author's repository).

thumb.description: The tile picture, kept in this repository beside the entry (reviewed with it).

blocked.description: Take-down: mirrors hide these games and refuse to start an installed copy.
